title: Outdoor birthday turned craft life savor.
text: Outdoor birthday turned craft life savor.. Intended for an outdoor birthday party and we had so much left that now we use it to cover our table when doing crafts.

product_metadata.title: Neatiffy Disposable Plastic Table Cloth Roll | 54 in x 108 Ft Waterproof Tablecloth | Table Cover for Rectangle, Square, Round Oval Tables | Picnic, Party, Banquet, Birthdays, Weddings - Pink
features: ✔️PREMIUM QUALITY & 100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEE: Our party essential roll is smell-free made of thick plastic which weighs 110g per 54" x 108" sheet (20g more than others). It can cover up to 12 big 8-inch long tables. Our high-quality plastic cover is wrinkle-resistant, providing superior protection to your table against stains, spills, and scratches at outdoor or indoor events.

✔️SLIDE-CUTTER FOR CUSTOM LENGTH: Cut to suit your preference and party needs! Each roll of tablecloth is equipped with a slide cutter, allowing you to create a perfectly sized plastic cover for Rectangle, Square, Round or Oval tables. Our covers are neatly rolled in a box, so you can cut as much as you need while keeping the rest for later.

✔️MULTI-PURPOSE: An ideal choice for Picnic, Party, Banquet, Birthdays, Weddings, Valentines day decor, Thanksgiving dinners, Christmas celebrations, BBQ or other festival occasions and food services. These pink tablecloths are perfect for kids' arts and crafts table or as plastic drop cloths for painting.

✔️STYLE AND DECORATION: Perfect to add to the style and décor of your event, these great table cloths will light up your room and holiday parties. A wide range of colors to select from to match the existing interior of your kitchen or dining area.

✔️EASY TO CLEAN: Simply roll up the tablecloth and dispose of it, or wipe down and store for next time. It's non-toxic, odorless, recyclable and economical with zero-waste. If you are tired of washing up all of your tablecloths, we’ve got the perfect solution!
